title: Oasis Dapp
tagline: Oasis is a Lens Protocol Mobile first PWA Dapp featuring new Lens V2 Smart Posts
description:
Core Features of Oasis
Mobile-First Design: Oasis is meticulously designed for mobile users, ensuring a seamless and intuitive user experience on smartphones and tablets. The user interface is responsive, adapting to different screen sizes and orientations to provide an optimal viewing experience.

Lens Protocol Integration: Leveraging the Lens Protocol, Oasis offers a decentralized approach to social media. This means users have greater control over their data, privacy, and interactions within the app, fostering a community-driven environment.

Smart-Posts: A unique feature of Oasis is its smart-posts capability. These are not just regular social media posts; they are embedded with smart contract functionalities. This could include features like automatic royalty distribution for content creators, voting mechanisms, or conditional visibility based on user interactions.

Progressive Web App (PWA): Oasis is also a PWA, which means it combines the best of web and mobile applications. Users can access it directly through a web browser without needing to download a traditional app, but it still offers an app-like experience including offline capabilities, push notifications, and fast load times.

Community-Driven Experience: The app encourages user participation and content creation, fostering a vibrant, engaged community. Users can create, share, and interact with content in a decentralized ecosystem, supporting freedom of expression and content ownership.
how_its_made:
Decentralized Identity and Authentication: Utilizing blockchain technology for identity management, Oasis ensures that users have secure and sovereign control over their digital identities.

Data Privacy and Security: Built with privacy in mind, the app ensures user data is protected. The decentralized nature of Lens Protocol means no central authority has control over user data.

Scalability and Performance: As a PWA, Oasis is designed for performance and scalability. It's lightweight and optimized for low bandwidth consumption, ensuring accessibility even in areas with limited internet connectivity.

Cross-Platform Accessibility: While being mobile-first, Oasis is also accessible on desktop browsers, offering a unified experience across different devices.
